_note: Mock customer feedback dataset for Indian banks. Used by the Generic Scraper Intake node as a stand-in for a real MouthShut/Trustpilot scraper. Each review carries its own 'bank' field so the Scraper: Map To Raw node can attribute it correctly across the 5 configured banks.

reviews.review_text: Worst experience with HDFC. Mobile app crashes every time I try to do NEFT. Customer care keeps putting me on hold for 40 minutes. Considering switching banks.
reviews.author: rahul_sharma

reviews.review_text: HDFC premium banking is excellent. My relationship manager is responsive and helped me close my home loan paperwork in 2 days.
reviews.author: priya_nair

reviews.review_text: Average service. ATM often out of cash on weekends. Branch staff is polite but processes are slow.
reviews.author: amit_verma

reviews.review_text: Charged 590 rupees as non-maintenance fee without any warning SMS. Complaint ignored for 3 weeks. Pathetic transparency.
reviews.author: suresh_iyer

reviews.review_text: ICICI iMobile app is fantastic. UPI, investments, cards all in one place. My go-to bank for 8 years.
reviews.author: kavya_reddy

reviews.review_text: Fraudulent transaction of 18000 rupees and ICICI took 21 days to refund. Unacceptable for a top private bank. Never recommending them again.
reviews.author: debanjan_ghosh

reviews.review_text: Home loan processed smoothly in 12 days. Documentation team was very supportive. Interest rate is competitive.
reviews.author: neha_kulkarni

reviews.review_text: Branch manager refused to accept my FD closure request citing system issues for 4 consecutive days. Total waste of time.
reviews.author: rajesh_khanna

reviews.review_text: SBI online banking is surprisingly good now. YONO app redesign has made daily transactions much easier. Still some queues at branch though.
reviews.author: deepak_mehta

reviews.review_text: Horrible service at this SBI branch. Staff takes 2 hour lunch breaks. Waited 3 hours just to update PAN. Would give zero stars if I could.
reviews.author: anupama_singh

reviews.review_text: Pension processing is always on time. Staff is respectful to senior citizens at this branch.
reviews.author: major_krishnan

reviews.review_text: Locker rent increased without prior notice. Customer is always the last priority. Public sector inefficiency at its peak.
reviews.author: sudipto_basu

reviews.review_text: Decent experience overall. KYC update took 3 visits but the staff was helpful once they understood the issue.
reviews.author: vishnu_rao

reviews.review_text: Priority banking at Axis BKC is top-notch. Dedicated RM answers calls even on Sundays. Worth the minimum balance.
reviews.author: tanvi_shah

reviews.review_text: Credit card was blocked without warning. Agent on call was rude and hung up twice. Applied for card closure today.
reviews.author: mohit_gupta

reviews.review_text: Good digital experience. The Axis mobile app is snappy and UPI works reliably. Physical branch is crowded though.
reviews.author: lakshmi_rajan

reviews.review_text: Hidden charges on my savings account. Quarterly fees never disclosed at account opening. Misleading fine print.
reviews.author: ashish_patil

reviews.review_text: Kotak 811 zero balance account is perfect for students. Everything digital, KYC was done via video in 5 minutes.
reviews.author: rohan_desai

reviews.review_text: Customer service is the worst I have experienced. They transferred my call 7 times and still couldn't resolve a simple debit card replacement.
reviews.author: sneha_pillai

reviews.review_text: Savings interest rate is competitive compared to other private banks. App has lots of features but takes time to learn.
reviews.author: harsh_patel

reviews.review_text: Branch opening hours are too limited. Only 10am to 3:30pm on weekdays. Working professionals have no chance of visiting.
reviews.author: kiran_bhatia
